generation.scope: Every singular distinct opposite matrix on any finite window is a global Gram matrix UU^t for a four-by-three matrix of linear forms. The isotropic determinant pencil is a nonzero binary octic and its cubic minors have a common divisor of degree two, three or four. The proof uses the local alternating trace pairing on a planar contact quotient and the length at most three on any line.

open_mathematics: Exploit the rank-two fibers of the global Gram pencil, especially its finite contact schemes and their spanning planes, to classify or exclude the residual singular opposite roots. Continue the unaffected general regularity and global branch work.
